 JOHNSON CITY, Tenn. (WCYB) — ETSU returns to action Saturday at VMI after an extra week to prepare for the Keydets’ unique offense and work on its own game.
 The Buccaneers went into their bye week unbeaten in Southern Conference play and in first place. They have five games left to finish the season strong, starting in Lexington, Virginia, where ETSU coach Will Healy said it can be tough to play.
 “I enjoy the atmosphere at VMI,” Healy said. “I played there whenever I was at Richmond and coached there a couple of times whenever I’ve been at other places in this league.”
 Healy praised VMI’s campus and crowd, saying the Keydets’ fans do everything they can to help their team win.
